title: 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Teal Explosion #163 Evan Turner Portland Trailblazers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops trading card features Evan Turner of the Atlanta Hawks. The card is a part of the Teal Explosion parallel/variety from the base set. The card number is 163 and it is from the 2019-20 season. It is a sports trading card for basketball fans and collectors. The card is manufactured by Panini, a well-known brand in the industry. The card is not autographed and is in excellent condition. It is a must-have for fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and the Atlanta Hawks.
